profile.headline: Software Engineer at Databricks
profile.summary:
I'm a software engineer at Databricks working on the distributed caching team.

I recently finished my PhD working in operating systems, advised by Dr. Tom Anderson and Dr. Danyang Zhuo at Duke University. I focused on improving the development velocity of Linux kernel modules by enabling modules written in safe Rust and providing support for debugging in userspace and transparent reloading of modules. In my first project, Bento, we focused on kernel file systems and built a file system that performed competitively with Linux Ext4. This paper won the Best Paper award at FAST '21. We extended these ideas to schedulers in our paper Enoki, which will appear in Eurosys 2024. Enoki also supports schedulers that coordinate with userspace and record and replay debugging.

Throughout work on this project, I have mentored several undergraduate students through research, including one undergraduate thesis. Their work contributed to our award-winning paper at FAST '21, and our submitted paper.

I have four internships at Google working on networking, distributed systems, and operating systems, consecutively from after my freshman year of undergraduate to the summer after I graduated with my bachelor's.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Software Engineer on the caching team

positions.title: PhD. Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: I worked on ChromeOS, improving robustness of tooling. I implemented portions of the tooling in Rust, reducing the potential for bugs. I also improved security of the tools by introducing a BSD-style jail around the tools, limiting the capabilities of that tool.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: I worked on Google Compute Engine in the Kernel & Devices team. My project was to improve memory usage by modifying KVM in Google GCE's production kernel.

positions.title: Engineering Practicum Intern
positions.description: I worked on enhancing and optimizing both the backend and frontend of data visualization for Google Cloud Dataflow. My contribution involved adding information used to debug an issue in production and reducing memory usage on the frontend by 60%.

positions.title: Engineering Practicum Intern
positions.description: I worked on latency testing doing two projects. The first project involved traffic shaping using tc on Linux devices. The second used packet capturing to collect latency data.
